[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Ashel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a crew-member of the Imperial refueling depot [[Bannistar Station]]. In about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while Ashel was on duty in the [[Space station/Legends|installation's]] Command and Control facility he was [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] by [[Arno D'Vox]], the station [[Commander/Legends|commander]], who ordered Ashel to have some of the facility's refueling modules moved, so as to make space for a concert to be held by the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]].
